notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.0.2
notes.content:
A new update containing improvements and balances has just been released. Specifically:

[list]
[*] Balanced the damage and attack speed of enemies: this change aims to achieve a more enjoyable experience without sacrificing the overall difficulty of the game
[*] Added a better graphical effect when an enemy is hit
[*] Improved the text of some items
[*] When playing with a controller, the first enemy hit is automatically locked
[*] Minor quality of life improvements
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who provided feedback and to everyone who played the game!

For all those who have abandoned it or haven't played it yet, we recommend trying it again with this new version and if you have any feedback we are here to listen!

notes.title: Announcing: Coral & The Abyss
notes.content:
[i]"They said that the Crystal Mountain would allow us to colonize the planet of salvation, but now it's just a wreck stranded on a hostile and uninhabitable world. I will not find peace until I find all the survivors, even if I have to explore every inch of what remains of my old world, the new one, and the abyss that surrounds us."[/i] - Coral

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3123920/Coral__The_Abyss/]Wishlist now![/url]

Coral & The Abyss is a sci-fi 2D action RPG with skilled hack’n slash combat and soulslike elements where you explore a mysterious world filled with ambiguous characters and challenging enemies. Explore, fight and survive as you ascend to the peak of the abyss.
